title: Critical limits of generating functions for face-constrained labelled planar maps
summary: We study connected planar maps with a fixed number of numbered faces, whose vertices carry integer labels such that the minimum label along the boundary of each face is one. Each face has its own positive weight, and an edge shared by two faces receives the geometric mean of their weights. For any fixed number $k\ge3$ of faces, we prove that the suitably rescaled generating function converges locally uniformly as the face weights approach the critical value $1/12$, possibly at different positive rates.
